name: Valahnúkur, Þórsmörk
why: The hut's own hill: an hour up and down for the view over the braided Krossá, three glaciers and the whole of Þórsmörk.
book: Free. Þórsmörk is reached by highland bus (fords no rental car may cross); sleep at Langidalur (Ferðafélag Íslands) or Húsadalur.
water: Fill up at the hut; nothing on the hill.
dangers: The last stretch to the summit is steep loose tuff: slippery when wet.
turnaround: In fog the view is gone: keep it for a clear evening.

points.name: Langidalur hut (Skagfjörðsskáli)
points.note: The Ferðafélag Íslands hut in the birches, the path starts behind it.

points.name: Krossá view on the ridge
points.note: Halfway up the birch slope: the grey braids of the Krossá below Eyjafjallajökull.

points.name: Valahnúkur summit
points.note: 458 m, with a view dial: Eyjafjallajökull, Mýrdalsjökull and Tindfjallajökull, the Markarfljót plain to the west.
